evals.prompt: We're starting the GovStack RegBB integration for our spec-to-code Joget build in Progressa. Write a short design note (markdown) for how learner_registration submissions get transmitted from the school-facing Joget instance to the back-office instance of PLR, the learner registry: which artefacts are involved, where each piece of configuration lives, and the concrete implementation steps. Save it as regbb-submission-design.md.
evals.expected_output: Design note that derives the channel contract from the application model via an emitter (never hand-authored), uses the activator/submitter/receiver triad as catalog components, deploys one stamped contract to both ends, and puts GovStack paths/identifiers/endpoint config in the model.

evals.prompt: I need to author learner_registration.yml for the submitter plugin. Give me a plan (markdown file plan.md): what sections the file needs, and how we'll keep it in sync with the copy the receiver loads on the receiving side.
evals.expected_output: Recognises hand-authoring as the failure mode: proposes generating the contract from the application model (emitter), explains the section shape (service/metadata/entities/serviceConfig/formMappings + validation-rules), and solves sender/receiver sync by one-source generation + provenance stamp verification rather than manual synchronisation.
